5d1fc77e-706a-4fc5-bea8-486c9be0145d.title: Vinland Saga
5d1fc77e-706a-4fc5-bea8-486c9be0145d.description:
As a child, Thorfinn sat at the feet of the great Leif Ericson and thrilled to wild tales of a land far to the west. But his youthful fantasies were shattered by a mercenary raid. Raised by the Vikings who murdered his family, Thorfinn became a terrifying warrior, forever seeking to kill the band's leader, Askeladd, and avenge his father. Sustaining Thorfinn through his ordeal are his pride in his family and his dreams of a fertile westward land, a land without war or slavery... the land Leif called Vinland.
___
- **Won the Japan Media Arts Award Division Grand Prize in 2009**
- **Won the 36th Kodansha Manga Award for General Manga in 2012**

1b0c80ec-c8db-43c1-840c-6d126c78d09f.altTitle: The Strongest Magical Swordsman Ever Reborn as an F-Rank Adventurer
1b0c80ec-c8db-43c1-840c-6d126c78d09f.description: Aizawa Yuri telah bereinkarnasi sebanyak 2x dan ia telah lelah menjadi penguasa ini dan itu. Dengan skill miliknya memungkinkan ia mendapatkan artefak reinkarnasi, dan ia memulai kesehariannya di dunia barunya!

e0c6cde1-232e-45de-8e0d-b6902c1453d0.title: Nageki no Bourei wa Intai Shitai ~Saijaku Hunter ni Yoru Saikyou Party Ikuseijutsu~
e0c6cde1-232e-45de-8e0d-b6902c1453d0.altTitle: Let this Grieving Soul Retire: Woe is the Weakling Who Leads the Strongest Party
e0c6cde1-232e-45de-8e0d-b6902c1453d0.description:
The golden age of treasure hunters who seek wealth, honor, power and glory, and explore dungeons around the world without regard to the danger. "Lets be treasure hunters," said Cry Andolihy, who swore an oath with his childhood friends to become the strongest... but he discovered during his first quest that he has no talent. But that was only the beginning of his adventure.  
  
"I can't do this anymore. I want to quit."
"Oh, I see. In other words, we should fight harder and cover for you, that's a good handicap."  
"Rest assured, Cry. We'll protect you!"  
"Oh, wait. If you step on that, the trap will destroy you without leaving a speck of dust behind. Be careful, Leader!"

Protected by his overpowered childhood friends, sought out by newbies and nobles, they aim to be heroes and find powerful treasures. Will Cry really be able to retire safely from being a Treasure Hunter?
___
[Alt Official English](https://global.bookwalker.jp/series/276659/)

f4fa82a7-4c09-4906-b3f3-80f8a30bae54.title: Yoimiya Nagi ga Mane ni Yashoku wo Tsukuru Wake
f4fa82a7-4c09-4906-b3f3-80f8a30bae54.altTitle: The Reason Yoimiya Nagi Makes Late-Night Meals for Her Manager
f4fa82a7-4c09-4906-b3f3-80f8a30bae54.description: “I’ll come make you a late-night meal again tomorrow.” This is a late-night-meal love comedy about Nagi Yoimiya, the vocalist of a hugely popular band, and her manager. Despite her busy life as a band member, Nagi comes to make late-night meals for her manager, bringing the two closer together through their after-hours meals.

0e8fac17-979e-4e37-8f45-2c334b25d6dd.title: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau
0e8fac17-979e-4e37-8f45-2c334b25d6dd.description:
Bubbly, energetic first-year high school student Himari falls head over heels for her senpai Yori after hearing her band perform on the first day of school. Himari tells Yori she just loves her, and, to Himari’s surprise, Yori says she loves Himari back! But when Himari realizes that she and her senpai are feeling two different kinds of love, she begins to ask herself what “love” really means…

*Source: Kodansha Comics, Vol. 1*

a24708e4-a3ad-4537-9ff7-b518b618d0b1.title: ZIGA
a24708e4-a3ad-4537-9ff7-b518b618d0b1.description:
Many Shonen Jump characters have big dreams, but this character's big dream is a nightmare! A very realistic reoccurring nightmare where a giant monster destroys a city. And it always ends with Kou, the poor dreamer, getting crushed under the rubble. But when Kou meets an unusual man who somehow knows about the monster in his dream, his nightmare takes on a whole new meaning.  
  
As a part of the JUMP START initiative, the first three chapters of Ziga were published in English in VIZ Media's digital Weekly Shonen Jump.

ddd42b12-b3e0-4731-a99b-73b8af4198b7.title: Super Rose
ddd42b12-b3e0-4731-a99b-73b8af4198b7.description:
Mayumi Makimura is the confident, bright young daughter of a famous professor working on an experimental submarine, the plans for which are being hunted by the female terrorist, Phantom Mouse. 

However, upon being hit by a meteor, Mayumi is given a form with otherworldly abilities. And in this form, she takes the name 'Super Rose'...

8e904201-718a-45f6-ae44-0e6d7f8c4aa3.title: Motokano Sensei wa, Choppiri Ecchi na Katei Houmon de Kimi to no Ai wo Hagukumitai.
8e904201-718a-45f6-ae44-0e6d7f8c4aa3.altTitle: Ex-girlfriend Teachers Want to Nurture Love by Making Slightly Naughty Visits to Your Home
8e904201-718a-45f6-ae44-0e6d7f8c4aa3.description:
The new teachers at high school student Touma Nijino's school are his ex-girlfriends who dumped him in the past! Moreover, both Akari Akamine and  Kohaku Shirasawa are still in love with him. He is happy to see them again, but... But he is not happy to see them again...

"Hey, can I kiss you?"
"Do you hate sleeping with me?"

They start competing with each other at the same time, trying to make a fait accompli with Touma before graduation. Moreover, they live in the same apartment complex as Touma and are trying to secretly nurture their love as a "commuter wife"...?

877bcca6-52dc-436c-ad24-f6c351232350.title: Yuutousei ga Adult Goods o Kai ni Kita
877bcca6-52dc-436c-ad24-f6c351232350.altTitle: The High School Girl Came to Buy Adult Toys.
877bcca6-52dc-436c-ad24-f6c351232350.description: Aya Mizuki, a high school girl working part-time at a secondhand bookstore that also sells adult goods, one day runs into Yuki Chino, an honors student from her class, right in the adult section. Yuki, who is highly respected at school, is surprisingly examining items for "stress relief." Sharing this little secret, their relationship gradually deepens. A high school girl-meets-girl story that begins with an unexpected encounter.

4feac959-e570-4b02-8341-9137db547846.title: We Need Your Sponsorship
4feac959-e570-4b02-8341-9137db547846.description:
After reincarnating as a villainous orphanage director destined for a grim end, she tries to rewrite her fate by caring for the children she once mistreated. But with the orphanage on the brink of collapse, she strikes a deal with a fearsome duke for help. 

As love blooms unexpectedly, can she protect both the children and her new future?
___
After dying as an orphan unable to support her siblings, Siella Feiront is reincarnated as the villainess of a novel and the evil matron of Siella's Orphanage. Indignant at how poorly the children in her care have been treated, she immediately gets to work—repairing the rundown manor, buying the children clothes, and cooking nutritious meals—until she's left with next to no money. With her funds quickly deteriorating, Siella sets out on a mission: she must find a sponsor before it's too late!

5a3e8ea6-7383-4ed5-bcd1-e1cfa0cf8be6.title: The Lives of Eccentrics
5a3e8ea6-7383-4ed5-bcd1-e1cfa0cf8be6.description:
Explore the lives of the famous-yet-not-so-famous people of history; such as Nikola Tesla, Ty Cobb, Typhoid Mary, the woman behind the Winchester Mystery House, Kou Yoshio, and many more.  
  
[Series of one-shots](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=33311) published between 1989-2003, released a tanko volume in 2004 and a bunko release in 2012.  
  
(Art by Araki Hirohiko and Onikubo Hirohisa; all stories by Araki Hirohiko)

Danpei's daughter Danko, who inherited Danpei's soul, struggles to create the strongest super dodgeball team in the Reiwa Era! Will Danko be able to overcome the common sense of the modern world!? Look forward to all the beautiful girls passionately drawn by Koshita Tetsuhiro.
